rationale: A run can span multiple waves, so a run-level wave cost is ambiguous. Attach the non-negative integer estimate to each concrete initial wave, whose shard set, duration, and concurrency define what is being estimated.
alternatives: derive the estimate from a versioned provider pricing input if one becomes part of the plan
remove it if estimates have no admission-control or reporting consumer
simplestChoice: Move it to initial_waves[] as estimated_cost_microusd.
